device_label: Design #1: 10 mm quartz/air/glycerol, G = 5.0 um, ng 4.3
substrate: quartz, 500 um thick, with a 4 um air undercut
cladding: glycerol (eps_r 44) upper cladding over SiO2; air bottom cladding (undercut)
notes: Simulated design (CST RF, Lumerical optical), not fabricated; wavelength not stated. Table 1 design #1: Vpi 0.84 V, 3-dB EO bandwidth 219 GHz, optical bandwidth 3.3 nm, metal-induced optical loss 0.042 dB/cm (not a total propagation loss; about 4 dB/m in the conclusion). Vpi is the DC value (p.7: RF Vpi scales with 1/|H|). VpiL 0.84 V cm is stated for the quartz/air/glycerol G = 5 um case (p.7). Overlap integral 0.74 at 0.8 um waveguide displacement toward the signal electrode (glycerol). RF loss 4.7 dB/cm at 219 GHz (3.0 dB/cm at 10 GHz) for G = 5 um from the RF-line figure text; nRF stays within 0.06 of ng = 4.3 up to 219 GHz and Z0 50 ohm is matched by tuning the inductance (p.6, no single measured value). Electrode: T-rail interdigitated segmented line, period 20 um, rail 18 um (90% duty, 2 um inter-rail), unloaded gap 26 um, ground width 100 um, T-head 8.5 um, digit length 25 um, digit width 6 um, T-stem 2 x 18 um (p.6). Grating waveguide: pitch detuning 39 nm, corrugation widths 0.56 and 1.02 um (p.5). Fig. 6(a) legend gives lengths only, so the 3-dB points of other lengths are not entered. The conclusion rounds the bandwidth to about 220 GHz. Figures give about 207 GHz (Fig. 6(a)/(b), 10 mm) and about 210 GHz (Fig. 7(a), case 6), read from the figures; 219 kept (Table 1 and text, four statements).

device_label: 7 mm PLACE MZM with SiON overcladding and SSC
il_onchip_excludes: spot-size-converter to UHNA fiber coupling (about 1.0 dB per facet)
substrate: Si substrate with SiO2 bottom cladding
notes: Fabricated by PLACE on a commercial x-cut LNOI wafer (NanoLN), MMI splitter and combiner, GSG CPW electrodes with 50 ohm terminal pads, SiON overcladding, LN inverse-taper SSCs. Vpi 3.1 V from a 100 kHz, 20 V peak-to-peak triangle sweep (Fig. 6(a)); VpiL 2.16 V cm as stated (3.1 V x 0.7 cm = 2.17 V cm). 3-dB EO bandwidth beyond 50 GHz limited by the 50 GHz VNA (10 MHz to 50 GHz); the Fig. 6(c) trace has a +1 dB bump near 1 GHz and touches the -3 dB line near 28, 35 and (single point) 38 GHz and at the 50 GHz end point. Fiber-to-fiber loss about 2.6 dB = about 1.0 dB per facet (from 2.0 dB fiber-to-fiber of a 1 mm straight LN waveguide, propagation neglected) + about 0.6 dB on-chip. Static ER 18 dB (Fig. 6(b)) from the same sweep. Electrical (EE) S21 roll-off of the 7 mm electrode 4.9 dB at 50 GHz (not an EO value). Gap 5.5 um and etch 0.21 um are the chosen design values (p.2); film thickness is the wafer specification; no SEM-measured dimensions are stated. Optical input power not stated. Vpi convention and push-pull drive are inferred from the GSG layout with one arm in each gap (authors do not state them).

device_label: Cascaded dual-MZI TFLN amplitude modulator (photon-statistics transducer)
notes: Two serial MZIs (push-pull traveling-wave electrodes, lift-off metal) coupled by a 2x2 directional coupler; mean splitter ratio 75/25 with 4% standard deviation; the stages cannot be driven independently. Static ER 51 dB at optimized bias equals the noise floor of the setup (entered as a lower bound); the fit suggests about 60 dB potential (Fig. 3(b)). Vpi approximately 3.4 V at 1550 nm (Methods, 'as shown in Figure 3'; stage not specified, frequency not stated, entered as DC-type). Fitted phase slopes printed as 0.88 and 0.60 'V/rad' for EOM1 and EOM2 (Eq. 5, 6): read as rad/V they imply Vpi of about 3.6 V and 5.2 V, not entered; Fig. 3(b) top axis puts pi near 5 V for modulator 2. Grating couplers for C-band, bare die on a PCB, wire-bonded RF; no thermal tuning or bias stabilization. Not reported: length, bandwidth, insertion loss, electrode geometry, drive amplitude, optical input power, foundry name.
